verdict.rationale: Evidence shows skills.sh/CLI works with SKILL.md files conforming to the open Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io), supports 75+ agents, and explicitly markets cross-product reuse ('build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent'), plus a validator (skills-ref validate) tied to the spec. missing for 10: no independent third-party audit confirming full spec compliance beyond vendor docs, and no explicit interoperability test showing a skill authored elsewhere works unmodified in skills.sh tooling.
